13:15.race_name: Betfair Racing Podcasts Juvenile Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Clear 2nd in 4yo handicap at Punchestown last time; could have part to play on yard debut
runners.name: Bibe Mus
runners.spotlight: French Flat winner who scored on hurdle debut at Gowran Park (2m, yielding) in October and has continued to run well, finishing a clear second in a 4yo handicap at Punchestown (2m, heavy) in January on final outing for Ross O'Sullivan; could have a part to play on stable debut.

runners.comment: Set to score at Fontwell only to fall at final flight but needs improvement on h'cap debut
runners.name: Turenne
runners.spotlight: French winner (2m, very soft) who was set to score at Fontwell (2m1f, heavy) in December on second British start only to fall at the final flight and hand victory to The Bellhop; third when odds-on at Ffos Las (2m, heavy) since; improvement needed in first-time hood/tongue-tie on handicap debut.

runners.breeder: K MoriceP MosbeuxAdes Hazan & R Ades
runners.comment: Two wins at Fontwell in the autumn and could have potential off opening mark
runners.name: Galactique
runners.spotlight: Won at Fontwell (2m1f, good) in September on second hurdle start and followed up there in October (2m1f, good to soft) in a race that worked out well; heavy ground may have been too much in Grade 2 at Cheltenham in November; unraced on soft; he could have potential off his opening mark.

runners.comment: 2-3 over hurdles, albeit fortunate on second occasion; improvement needed, but possible
runners.name: The Bellhop
runners.spotlight: Won on hurdle debut at Fontwell (2m1f, good) in October before Listed fourth at Wetherby; back on the scoresheet at Fontwell (2m1f, heavy) in December albeit looked booked for second prior to Turenne's final-flight fall; improvement is necessary now tackling a handicap but can't be ruled out.

runners.comment: Third in good races on last two starts and she's in with a chance in her first handicap
runners.name: Only One Blue
runners.spotlight: Won on hurdle/stable debut at Sedgefield (2m1f, good) in October and has continued to run well; Listed third at Aintree in December (2m1f, soft; on which she's closely matched with runner-up Bibe Mus today) and the form of her third at Chepstow (2m, soft) in January has worked out well; chance.

runners.comment: Up and down in short career but won two runs ago; not ruled out in first-time cheekpieces
runners.name: Diamond Jim
runners.spotlight: He's been a bit up and down in his short career and better could have been expected at Warwick in January; however, he was a promising second on debut at Bangor (2m, soft) in November and won at Haydock (1m7f, good) in December; not ruled out in first-time cheekpieces on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Clear with odds-on winner when second on British debut and he's open to improvement
runners.name: Superkap
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on second and final start in France (2m2f, very soft) last May and filled the same position when 11-2 on last month's stable debut at Hereford (2m, heavy); came clear with the odds-on winner last time and he's open to improvement; could give a good account.

runners.comment: He's got better with each of his three runs over hurdles and could continue to progress
runners.name: Knighton
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on sole Flat start and he's got better with each of his three runs over hurdles, last time 7l fourth of eight at Market Rasen (2m, soft); now goes handicapping off a modest mark and he could continue to progress.

13:50.race_name: European Breeders' Fund Betfair "National Hunt" Novices' Handicap Hurdle Final (Premier Hcap) (GBB)

runners.comment: Beat subsequent Grade 2 winner Klub De Reve at Exeter but turned over at odds-on next time
runners.name: Gentleman Toboot
runners.spotlight: Point/bumper winner who made it 2-2 over hurdles when beating subsequent Dovecote winner Klub De Reve under a penalty at Exeter (2m, good to soft); however, he was turned over at odds-on at Leicester later in December and needs to bounce back.

runners.comment: Disappointing in Grade 2 at Doncaster six weeks ago and others may have more potential
runners.name: Get On George
runners.spotlight: Best effort when defying a penalty at Doncaster (2m3f, good; beat Draco Malfoy by 2l) in December, but disappointing in a Grade 2 there six weeks ago; others may have more potential.

runners.comment: Progressing rapidly and completed hat-trick at Windsor; high on the list
runners.name: Scorpio Rising
runners.spotlight: Progressing rapidly and completed a hat-trick of hurdles wins at Windsor (2m4f, soft) in January, coming from rear; more improvement required off 7lb higher mark and that's entirely possible; high on the list.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras DEnki
runners.comment: Might have followed up Hereford win with more fluent round of jumping at Ascot; respected
runners.name: Laguna Beach
runners.owner: M Buckley C Noell And M Hankin
runners.spotlight: Hereford win (2m3f, good to soft) worked out well and he might have followed up at Ascot (2m5f, soft) with a more fluent round of jumping; still unexposed and not ruled out.

runners.comment: Beat The Boss Bear 20l at Fakenham; this is stronger but he still has untapped potential
runners.name: Jurys In
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner with a progressive profile over hurdles; readily pulled 20l clear of The Boss Bear at Fakenham (2m4f, soft) three weeks ago; this is more competitive but he still has untapped potential.

runners.comment: Easy Kelso winner; this step back up in trip is a plus; might have been let in lightly
runners.name: Kakas Cousin
runners.spotlight: Improving at a rate of knots over hurdles and easily beat ten rivals at Kelso (2m, heavy) last month; stepping back up in trip should be in his favour and he might have been let in lightly on handicap debut; big chance.

runners.comment: Second to Get On George at Doncaster before landing odds at Hereford; needs a bit more
runners.name: Draco Malfoy
runners.owner: Sir F Brooke & Sir R Pilkington
runners.spotlight: Good second to Get On George at Doncaster (2m3f, good) before landing the odds in a small field at Hereford (2m5f, soft) in January; probably needs a bit more on today's handicap debut.

runners.comment: Not hard pressed to get off the mark at Market Rasen; has to be considered
runners.name: Cinquenta
runners.spotlight: Represents the same trainer and jockey combination as last year's winner, Laurens Bay; beaten a neck by Precious Metal at Lingfield in December but off the mark at Market Rasen (2m5f, good to soft) seven weeks later, not hard pressed to assert; has to be considered.

runners.comment: Only second at Ffos Las two weeks ago and has something to find with several of these
runners.name: Rathkenny
runners.spotlight: Made all at Doncaster (2m3f, soft) in January but could not pull off the same feat in a small field at Ffos Las two weeks ago and has something to find with several of these.

runners.comment: Made all in a canter at Plumpton; very interesting contender now tackling handicaps
runners.name: Tennessee Tango
runners.spotlight: Took a few goes to get off the mark over hurdles but did so in emphatic fashion at Plumpton (2m, soft), making all in a canter; bred to be suited by 2m4f+ and is a very interesting contender now tackling handicaps.

runners.comment: Hasn't progressed as expected; hopes rest on change of trainer and fitting of tongue-strap
runners.name: Race To Base
runners.spotlight: Hasn't progressed as expected since Hereford win (2m, good) in the autumn and finished only fourth in handicap there in January; hopes rest on a change of trainer (same ownership) and the fitting of a tongue-strap.

runners.comment: Two promising efforts for current yard; step back up in trip a major plus;  unexposed
runners.name: Unknown Entity
runners.spotlight: Showed promise earlier in career for Willie Mullins and has shaped well on both starts for current yard, pulling clear with the odds-on favourite at Wincanton (1m7f, soft) in January; promises to be well suited by today's step back up in trip and he's unexposed as he moves in to handicaps.

runners.comment: Bumped into useful type at Warwick two weeks ago and may not have reached ceiling just yet
runners.name: Four Springs
runners.spotlight: Made winning start over hurdles at Hereford (2m, good) and has shown better form since, bumping into a useful type at Warwick (2m3f, soft) two weeks ago; represents same connections as 2024 winner Champagne Twist, wears headgear for the first time and may not have reached his ceiling just yet.

runners.comment: Bit disappointing when stepped up in trip over C&D and now needs to get back on track
runners.name: Precious Metal
runners.spotlight: Bit disappointing when stepped up in trip over C&D (heavy) five weeks ago; had a solid record over 2m before then, winning at Lingfield (good to soft; by neck from Cinquenta), but he now needs to get back on track.

runners.comment: Has looked ready for 2m4f+ in three hurdles runs; gets that here and can improve
runners.name: Wolf Walker
runners.owner: Robert Fear And Mrs Tracey Ham
runners.spotlight: Has a different profile from most of these, having won three points in 2023-24 and begun his rules career with a run in a 3m2f hunter chase; solid second in 1m7f/2m hurdles this season, looking ready for a return to longer distances; gets that here and can improve now tackling a handicap.

runners.comment: 0-3 over hurdles, put firmly in place by Cinquenta at Market Rasen five weeks ago
runners.name: Gee Force Flyer
runners.spotlight: Won an Irish point but is 0-3 over hurdles, put firmly in place by Cinquenta at Market Rasen (2m5f, good to soft) five weeks ago; one of two runners for Olly Murphy and Scorpio Rising looks the first string.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De Montaigu
runners.comment: Third behind Cinquenta and Gee Force Flyer at Market Rasen last time; this is warmer
runners.name: Roi Du Risk
runners.spotlight: Second runner for Henrietta Knight; scrambled home at Leicester (1m7f, soft) just after Christmas and ran about as well as could have been expected behind Cinquenta and Gee Force Flyer at Market Rasen (2m5f, good to soft) next time; this is warmer.

runners.comment: Well held by Jury's In penultimate start and ran poorly just 13 days ago; plenty to prove
runners.name: The Boss Bear
runners.spotlight: Won a good-ground bumper at Plumpton last spring and off the mark over hurdles there in December; however, he was well held by Jury's In next time and ran poorly (heavy ground) just 13 days ago; cheekpieces now fitted; fair bit to prove.

14:27.race_name: Betfair Imperial Cup Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Travelled strongly when second over 2m5f at Warwick; not ruled out now back down in trip
runners.name: Fingle Bridge
runners.spotlight: 3-3 over hurdles last season, including a Listed novice win at Exeter (2m, good to soft), and following a stint over fences he reverted to this sphere with a promising second at Warwick (2m5f, heavy) four weeks ago; travelled strongly on that latest start and not ruled out now back down in trip.

runners.comment: Disappointing at Windsor but solid record in this race and could bounce back with bold bid
runners.name: Knickerbockerglory
runners.spotlight: 10yo who was disappointing at Windsor in January; however, prior to that he went close behind Go Dante over this C&D (soft) and he has a strong record at Sandown, including form figures of 255 in this race; no surprise if this front-runner bounces back with a bold bid now back here.

runners.comment: Impressed in 4yo handicap on reappearance but has failed to shine on his three runs since
runners.name: Gibbs Island
runners.spotlight: Soft-ground maiden hurdle winner who impressed in 4yo handicap at Chepstow (2m, good) in October on reappearance; now only 2lb higher but he's failed to shine on his three outings since and needs to get back on track.

runners.breeder: N J Henderson And Mrs S A Aston
runners.comment: Has struggled elsewhere on last 2 runs but wind op since & has won last 2 runnings of this
runners.name: Go Dante
runners.spotlight: 10yo who was well beaten at Windsor in January and pulled up at Newbury last month; however, he's had wind surgery since and there can be optimism he'll be a different proposition now back here, having won the last two runnings of this race (soft/good to soft) and also scored over C&D in December.

runners.comment: Won Grade 2 mares' hurdle at Ascot in January and competitive off this mark in the past
runners.name: Ooh Betty
runners.spotlight: Can make the running; merely mid-division in this race 12 months ago and she's inconsistent, but she returned to form with Grade 2 mares' win at Ascot (1m7f, soft) in January; runs off same mark as for close third in Scottish Champion Hurdle last April (2m, good to soft) and not ruled out each-way.

runners.comment: Clear 2nd at Windsor last time behind Scorpio Rising who is declared for EBF Final at 1:50
runners.name: Top Jimmy
runners.spotlight: Front-runner; won at Uttoxeter (2m/2m4f, good/good to soft) in October on first two hurdle starts before third of five in Grade 2 here (2m4f, soft); again ran well when runner-up on handicap debut at Windsor (2m4f, soft) in January, when clear with Scorpio Rising who is declared for the EBF Final at 1:50, and this unexposed 6yo may benefit from the return to 2m; big player.

runners.comment: Bounced back to form with a bang at Newbury last week; this is hotter but not ruled out
runners.name: Rubber Ball
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with a bang when dropped back in trip and a well-backed winner at Newbury (2m, good to soft) last Saturday; now 8lb higher in a much hotter race but he's unexposed at this sort of distance and his stable is in tremendous form; has also won on soft ground; not ruled out.

runners.breeder: L De Premont & P Bollart & X Bollart
runners.comment: Defied huge absence with easy win at Aintree but well beaten at Newbury subsequently
runners.name: Bubble Dubi
runners.spotlight: Won at Chepstow (2m, heavy) in February 2024 and this 9yo was racing for the first time since when winning at Aintree (2m1f, good to soft) in November 2025; he's a lot better than he showed at Newbury latest (2m, heavy; again failed to settle) but is hard to fancy on the back of that heavy defeat.

runners.comment: Below par last autumn but a break may have helped; each-way shout on last August's form
runners.name: Messerschmitt
runners.spotlight: Irish-trained 5yo who failed to threaten on his last two hurdle starts last autumn; however, a break may have helped and he was a close third of 15 at Galway (2m1f, good) last August; his maiden hurdle win came on yielding to soft; has an each-way shout if back on song; tongue-tie is left off.

runners.comment: Won small-field handicap over C&D in November but disappointing on both hurdle runs since
runners.name: Nardaran
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who made it 2-2 for the season with comfortable win in four-runner handicap over C&D (good to soft) in November; disappointing over hurdles on next two starts; ran okay behind Constitution Hill on the AW at Southwell recently but others arrive with more pressing claims.

runners.comment: Returned from absence with easy, 50-1 win at Kempton; respected despite hotter company
runners.name: Gooloogong
runners.spotlight: In good form on AW last spring and returned from an absence for 50-1 win at Kempton (2m, good to soft) last month in his first handicap hurdle; faces tougher opposition today but did it very easily and a 10lb rise may not stop him if he can confirm that latest promise; probably okay on soft ground.

runners.comment: Mixed form since reappearance win at Newton Abbot; Top Jimmy looks the yard's chief hope
runners.name: Spirits Bay
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs P Carter J A B Old M Sanders
runners.spotlight: Ran okay when seventh in this last year and he reappeared with a win at Newton Abbot (2m1f, good to soft) in October; however, his subsequent form has been mixed (fences/hurdles) and Top Jimmy looks the yard's chief hope.

runners.comment: Runner-up at Cheltenham and Taunton on his last two starts and he's an each-way player
runners.name: Jack Hyde
runners.owner: Paddy Brennan Racing Syndicate Jack Hyde
runners.spotlight: Three novice hurdle wins last year (2m-2m4f, good to soft) and second of 15 at Cheltenham (2m, soft) in November when back in a handicap; also runner-up at Taunton last month (2m, heavy; would have been closer granted a clear run) when back from a three-month break (and wind op); each-way player.

runners.comment: Arrives with something to prove but he's 3lb lower than when second in this 12 months ago
runners.name: Wreckless Eric
runners.spotlight: He's been a long way below his best on his three starts this season and arrives with something to prove; however, there have been possible excuses on each occasion, namely the lack of a recent run, then the step up to 2m5f, and most recently heavy ground; now 3lb lower than when second in this 12 months ago (good to soft) and he's not written off in first-time headgear.

runners.comment: Won on handicap debut at Huntingdon in November and had an excuse at Musselburgh since
runners.name: Mr McLoughlan
runners.spotlight: A refusal to settle proved costly when down the field at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) on New Year's Day; however, it's highly likely there'll be more pace/cover in this field and the form of his handicap debut win at Huntingdon (2m, good to soft) in November worked out well; ran well on AW behind Constitution Hill a fortnight ago; could outrun his forecast big odds.

runners.comment: Big step back in right direction at Ascot three weeks ago and he might not be far away
runners.name: No Ordinary Joe
runners.spotlight: 10yo who had been struggling for his new yard this season but he's dropped down the weights and, with these cheekpieces applied, took a big step back in the right direction when fifth of 15 at Ascot (2m3f, good to soft) three weeks ago; he was in front jumping two out last time and could be suited by today's drop back in trip; might not be far away.

runners.comment: Retains potential off this hurdle mark in view of his classy Flat ability
runners.name: Mondo Man
runners.spotlight: Classy on the Flat; some warm tasks switched to hurdles last year, performing with credit more often than not; held up when fourth of 13 on handicap hurdle debut at Ascot (1m7f, good to soft) in December in a race that favoured those ridden prominently; has since easily justified 1-7 odds in Plumpton maiden (2m, soft); retains potential off this mark in view of Flat ability.

runners.comment: 6yo who has been progressive this season but further improvement is necessary today
runners.name: Were Red And Blue
runners.spotlight: 5l eighth of 17 in this last year (good to soft) and he's improved this season with a win at Huntingdon (2m, soft) in December and a good second at Kempton (2m, good) in January; further progress from this 6yo can't be ruled out, but it's certainly necessary in this hot handicap.

runners.comment: Wins at Musselburgh on last 2 runs; this progressive 5yo could have more left in the tank
runners.name: Star Of Guiting
runners.spotlight: Won at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) in January on third stable start and followed up there in the Scottish County Hurdle (1m7f, good to soft); has also shown promise on soft; he needs to prove he can do it on this different track but his come-from-behind style provides optimism this 5yo still has more left in the tank, and he's only 3lb higher than last time.

runners.comment: 5l win in small-field mares' race at Exeter; needs to be better than ever back up in grade
runners.name: Game Colours
runners.spotlight: Having shown some good form in defeat in handicaps (on various ground) she made the breakthrough in this sphere in a small-field, mares-only race at Exeter (2m, heavy) a fortnight ago; had 5l to spare but she'll need to be better than ever to follow up in this much more competitive contest.

runners.comment: Close third in this last year and runner-up at Musselburgh last time; each-way claims
runners.name: Afadil
runners.spotlight: 16 races and over two years since last win; however, close third in this last year (good to soft) and he was runner-up to Star Of Guiting at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) last time under Freddie Keighley; each-way claims.

runners.comment: Won on handicap debut at Newbury; up in grade but remains to be seen where limitations lie
runners.name: General Briar
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at Plumpton (2m, soft) in December on third hurdle start and followed up on handicap debut at Newbury (2m, good to soft) in January, again making the running; 5lb higher in this more competitive race but he did it nicely last time and it remains to be seen where his limitations lie.

runners.comment: Reserve; unable to pose a serious threat in Britain; still lightly raced & is in top hands
runners.name: Brace For Landing
runners.owner: Robert Kirkland And Neil & Alfie Smith
runners.spotlight: Reserve; unable to pose a serious threat across his three British starts, most recently fifth of eight over C&D (good) in January; however, perhaps today's softer ground will help this ex-French 5yo, who remains very lightly raced, and Harry Skelton rides him as opposed to stablemate and course specialist Knickerbockerglory; he might be worth a second look.

15:00.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Mares' Standard Open National Hunt Flat Race (Listed Race) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Won similar event at Huntingdon then ran well against males at Windsor; solid
runners.name: Timamzel
runners.spotlight: Above-average mare whose strong promise comprises a success in Listed event at Huntingdon and good effort under a penalty against males at Windsor, both on soft ground; concedes 4lb all round but looks rock solid.

runners.comment: Only midfield in the Huntingdon race won by Ti'mamzel when last seen
runners.name: Babs
runners.spotlight: Needs improvement having finished only midfield, on soft going, in the Huntingdon race won by Ti'mamzel when last seen; perhaps ideally needs drying ground, having gained her Stratford win on good.

runners.comment: Wasn't for catching at Warwick on rules debut; leading player on bare figures
runners.name: Burds Of A Feather
runners.spotlight: Record of 2-2 in completed starts, namely wide-margin wins on final attempt in Irish points and on rules debut; went freely to post and in the race at Warwick (soft) but wasn't for catching, having soon established a clear lead; leading player on bare figures.

runners.comment: Carlisle form for John Dawson suggests she needs to show progress
runners.name: Capricciose
runners.spotlight: Raced at Carlisle (soft) for John Dawson, finishing third to new stablemate Lune Brillante then winning a weaker contest; sold for £55,000 since; needs to show progress and has been deserted by Harry Skelton.

runners.comment: The only maiden in this field but is bred to do better still; possibilities
runners.name: Gidge
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced mare; the only maiden in this field but is bred to do better still, being a half-sister to smart stablemate Crambo, and ran well from the front in the Huntingdon contest won by Ti'mamzel when last seen (showed signs of post-race ataxia); tongue-tie now applied; possibilities.

runners.comment: Needs further improvement to follow up her Plumpton win
runners.name: Joans Choice
runners.spotlight: Form figures of 321 reflect a solid start to her career; however, faces a stiffer assignment upped in class and accordingly needs further improvement to follow up her Plumpton success (good to soft).

runners.comment: First past the post in both Irish points; brings potential to rules racing
runners.name: Kamille Au Kanada
runners.spotlight: First past the post in both Irish points, disqualified on first occasion (banned substance in sample); did it easily last time and subsequently sold for £72,000; tongue-tie fitted; brings potential to rules racing and market support would heighten interest.

runners.comment: Irish mare who has progressive RPRs; interesting with Harry Cobden booked
runners.name: Lennon Grove
runners.spotlight: Irish mare who opened her rules account in Thurles event (yielding to soft) on last appearance, adding to the point win that ties her in with Millstatt Abbey; has progressive RPRs and looks an interesting challenger, especially with Harry Cobden booked.

runners.comment: Skelton mare; open to progress back on a stiffer track; remains of interest
runners.name: Lune Brillante
runners.spotlight: Skelton mare who scored in clearcut fashion at Carlisle (soft) then looked unsuited by the track, admittedly still not disgraced, in the Huntingdon contest won by Ti'mamzel; open to progress back on a stiffer course and remains of interest.

runners.comment: Emphatic success at Uttoxeter on the switch to rules; promising sort
runners.name: Millstatt Abbey
runners.spotlight: Close second to Lennon Grove in Irish point then sold for 100,000euros; set for an interesting rematch with that rival, having gone one better in emphatic style at Uttoxeter (good to soft) on the switch to rules; promising sort who could prove a Listed/Graded mare.

runners.comment: This is a far cry from winning an ordinary contest on AW at Newcastle
runners.name: Orestina
runners.spotlight: Flat-bred mare who is the only once-raced contender in this field and possibly open to progress; however, in all sorts of ways this a far cry from comfortably winning an ordinary contest on AW at Newcastle.

runners.comment: Ran well in similar event at Market Rasen when bidding to take record to 3-3
runners.name: The Flaggy Shore
runners.spotlight: Couldn't quite justify favouritism but ran well, pulling clear of the third, in similar event at Market Rasen (good to soft) last time when bidding to take her overall record (point/bumpers) to 3-3; one of the main form contenders.

runners.comment: Took a big step forward to win by 8l at Wincanton; one to bear in mind
runners.name: Western Charm
runners.spotlight: Only midfield in the Plumpton race won by Joan's Choice but may reverse those placings, having surpassed that rival's RPR by taking a huge step forward to win by 8l at Wincanton (heavy); one to bear in mind, with further improvement plausible.

15:35.race_name: Best Odds On The Betfair Exchange Handicap Chase (Challenger Staying Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.comment: Won C&D veterans' event in November 2024 but pulled up next time and off 455 days since
runners.name: Certainly Red
runners.spotlight: Goes well here and won C&D veterans' event (good ground) in November 2024, but now returns from a long absence after pulling up on his only subsequent outing; probably vulnerable to younger legs.

runners.comment: Narrow C&D winner in December; needs to rebound after pulling up next time
runners.name: Welcom To Cartries
runners.spotlight: Up and down in his relatively short career to date; on a going day when holding on narrowly over C&D (good to soft) in December but then ran poorly at Ascot the following month; needs to rebound and that's not out of the question.

runners.comment: Better than ever when digging deep to win at Carlisle; yard won this in 2023; respected
runners.name: Sound And Fury
runners.spotlight: Showed himself better than ever when digging deep to win at Carlisle (3m, good to soft) last month; also successful over 3m2f there in November; yard won this race in 2023 and is having a stellar season with its chasers; has to be respected.

runners.comment: Won over 2m4f here on return; 4lb out of handicap last time; not ruled out off proper mark
runners.name: Invincible Nao
runners.spotlight: Versatile sort who won over 2m4f here on reappearance and has performed respectably over marathon trips since; stiff task from 4lb out of handicap last time; not ruled out back off proper mark.

runners.comment: Had fallen in the weights prior to winning at Ludlow last time; remains on a workable mark
runners.name: Bucksy Des Epeires
runners.spotlight: Had fallen in the weights prior to winning at Ludlow (3m, soft) 17 days ago, perked up by first-time cheekpieces; nudged back up 3lb but remains on a workable mark; high on the list.

runners.comment: Lightly raced 7yo; made immediate impact over fences when winning at Newbury; big player
runners.name: Calimystic
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 7yo; 1-3 over hurdles and made an immediate impact over fences when beating seven rivals at Newbury (2m6f, good) in December, travelling strongly and doing just enough after leading before two out; has more potential and commands respect off a 4lb higher mark.

runners.comment: Perth winner last summer; well held only start since and now returns from 112 days off
runners.name: Imperial Alex
runners.spotlight: 4-15 over fences, rallying to win at Perth (3m, good) last summer; got lost in a big field at Cheltenham when next seen in November, and he's been off another 112 days since; yard also runs Tune In A Box.

runners.comment: 0-4 over fences but more encouragement when third at Newbury; could be ready to strike
runners.name: Tune In A Box
runners.spotlight: Won four times over hurdles; little promise on his first three attempts at chasing but there was much more encouragement in a never-nearer third of ten at Newbury (2m7f, heavy) four weeks ago; has been dropped 10lb in the weights since his chasing debut and drying ground should not inconvenience him in the slightest; could be ready to strike.

runners.comment: Poor last time but previous run was creditable; could bounce back in first-time headgear
runners.name: Yes Day
runners.spotlight: A poor effort at Windsor last time has to be forgiven but he'd previously run creditably when third of seven there on New Year's Day; versatile trip-wise (effective at 2m4f and stays long distances); could bounce back in first-time headgear.

16:10.race_name: Betfair Exchange Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Could be well treated even if November's third to The Jukebox Man flatters him slightly
runners.name: Mr Hope Street
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful hurdler who stepped up on his Carlisle chase debut sixth when beaten just over 6l into third behind The Jukebox Man and Iroko in a Haydock graduation event over an extended 2m5f (good to soft) in November; while his proximity to that high-class pair almost certainly shouldn't be taken at face value he could still be well treated back in a handicap off 131.

runners.comment: Completed chase four-timer at Leicester on Fri but this would be a very quick turnaround
runners.name: Followcato
runners.spotlight: 0-5 over hurdles but a different proposition since switch to fences and fitted with cheekpieces, winning his last four (all right-handed), the latest over an extended 2m6f at Leicester (good to soft) on Friday; will carry a 7lb penalty in the unlikely event he turns out again.

runners.breeder: M Collet J Collet & M Collet
runners.comment: Won first two starts this winter; good effort from out of weights at Cheltenham since
runners.name: Just Over Land
runners.spotlight: Returned to win handicap chases at Fontwell and Chepstow (both 2m3f, good to soft) in November/December; fared about as well as could be expected from 10lb out of the weights when fourth of 12 in a valuable Premier Handicap at Cheltenham (just short of 2m5f, good) on New Year's Day; respected with his sights lowered.

runners.comment: Went close at Newbury (2m6f) over Christmas; possible excuses for poor run since; claims
runners.name: Captain Bellamy
runners.spotlight: Probably unlucky not to win a 2m6f Newbury handicap chase (good) just after Christmas when a late rally narrowly failed; well-beaten favourite back there (2m7f) four weeks ago but possible excuses emerged as Paul Nicholls reported that he was unsuited by the heavy ground and he was also found to have sustained a wound to his right hind; player if bouncing back to the level of that near miss over the festive period.

runners.comment: In good form this winter, winning hurdle then second on chase debut; may do better again
runners.name: Soldierofthestorm
runners.spotlight: Has shown career-best form since returning this winter, winning over hurdles at Catterick (2m3f, goods) then clear second at Hereford (2m5f, soft) on chase debut; may be capable of further progress.

runners.comment: Second in handicap hurdle on reappearance but two lesser runs since; makes chase debut
runners.name: Akimos
runners.spotlight: Soft-ground maiden hurdle winner last spring and bettered that form when second in 2m4f course handicap hurdle (good to soft) on reappearance; two lesser runs have followed, particularly when pulled up latest, and now switches to fences in a bid to resume his progression.

runners.comment: Four hurdle wins last year but comfortably held switched to fences in recent months
runners.name: Glen Road
runners.spotlight: Highly progressive over hurdles in 2025, winning four times (2m4f-2m7f, good to soft/soft), but he's performed below that level switched to fences in recent months; still early days in this sphere but difficult to make a case for him here.

runners.comment: Third over 2m at Carlisle recently and the step back up in trip might help
runners.name: Here Comes Georgie
runners.spotlight: Close second at Doncaster (2m3f, good to soft) in November and bounced back from Ascot blip when third at Carlisle (2m, good to soft) recently, albeit soundly beaten by the first two; the step back up in trip might help and he's a possible player if conditions suit; unproven on soft ground.

runners.comment: Won in decisive fashion over C&D last time and an 8lb rise might not stop him
runners.name: Norn Iron
runners.spotlight: Things clicked when he went up in trip over C&D (soft) in January in a first-time tongue-tie (retained) on his third chase start, and he won in decisive fashion from one who scored next time; 8lb rise might not stop him.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De La Haie Neuve Et Al
runners.comment: Won at Windsor then close second at Ludlow; solid claims
runners.name: Toothless
runners.spotlight: Won at Windsor (2m4f, good) on New Year's Day on second start back from a long absence and close second at Ludlow (2m4f, soft) last month behind one who was completing a hat-trick; Jay Tidball, who has been on board on his last two starts, remains in the saddle; solid claims.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De Saint-Vincent
runners.comment: Won at Taunton last January but at a shorter trip and this 10yo has been absent since
runners.name: First Angel
runners.spotlight: Made it two wins from his last three starts when scoring in good style at Taunton (2m, good to soft) last January; Sean Bowen is again in the saddle for this first run since but it's a hefty absence for this 10yo to defy and there is a question mark regarding today's longer trip.

14:05.race_name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap

runners.comment: Not seen to best effect last time and earlier Newcastle efforts bring him right into it
runners.name: Badri
runners.spotlight: Placed in both visits here and he ran good races at Newcastle (5f and 6f) around the turn of the year; wouldn't judge him too harshly on latest start and he is one to take seriously.

runners.comment: 7-18 on AW; goes well fresh and Oisin Murphy booked so can't discount despite lofty mark
runners.name: Cinque Verde
runners.spotlight: Seven wins from 18 AW runs, three of them here; wouldn't look to have much in hand of this mark but she goes well fresh and the booking of Oisin Murphy is a notable one.

runners.comment: Two wins for new yard this winter but latest effort needs some forgiveness
runners.name: Accrual
runners.spotlight: In good form around the turn of the year, winning 6f handicaps here and at Lingfield; stiff task in Listed company on penultimate start but latest Chelmsford run needs more forgiveness.

runners.comment: C&D winner in December; too keen at Kempton last time; not fully exposed
runners.name: Kullazain
runners.spotlight: Landed a gamble over C&D in December, his first run after a gelding operation; only third off this mark at Kempton last time where he was hamstrung by a refusal to settle; still lurks on an interesting mark and he is one to take seriously, even with the stable on a losing run of 25.

runners.comment: 2nd/4th in last two runnings; arrives on the back of a good Chelmsford win; solid claims
runners.name: Knebworth
runners.spotlight: Running in this race for the third time, having finished second in 2024 and fourth last year; those runs were after a break but he has the benefit of a run this time around, winning a 6f handicap at Chelmsford five weeks ago; still on a feasible mark and he is a key player for a stable going well.

runners.comment: Low-key stable debut at Newcastle four weeks ago (5f; after long absence); best watched
runners.name: Vingegaard
runners.spotlight: Sharp as 2yo for Archie Watson; absent for 501 days prior to his stable debut at Newcastle four weeks ago (5f), a race where he dropped away from over 1f out; needs to leave that well behind him.

runners.comment: Two wins this year and he was drawn wide when only 4th at Southwell last time; e-w shout
runners.name: Silky Wilkie
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing Lxxxi & E Burke
runners.spotlight: Ended a long losing run at Newcastle in January and successful again over C&D last month; poorly drawn when fourth at Southwell last time; one to consider.

runners.comment: Smart 2yo but only one run in last 574 days (well beaten); risky but worth a market check
runners.name: Dragon Leader
runners.spotlight: Smart 2yo, including an easy win in the Redcar Two-Year-Old Trophy; struggled as a 3yo and he has only been seen once since August 2024, a low-key 1m run at Newbury last April (after gelding and win surgeries); returns to sprinting off a reduced mark and he is worth a market check.

runners.breeder: S A S Ecurie De Cachene & Earl Haras D
runners.comment: Not firing on all cylinders at present; widest stall to defy; others are more appealing
runners.name: Tennessee Gold
runners.spotlight: Has looked good on occasions but he failed to win last year and he wasn't at his best at Southwell a fortnight ago; edging down the weights but needs a full revival if he is to take this from the widest stall.

runners.comment: Impressed from the front over C&D in January but up 6lb in a much better race; new yard
runners.name: Addarella
runners.spotlight: Had looked exposed prior to her impressive front-running C&D win for Marco Botti 47 days ago; 6lb rise against much stronger opposition could find her out.

runners.comment: Least exposed runner in the field; fine 2nd in the Britannia when last seen; more to come
runners.name: La Botte
runners.owner: Halo Racing N Greenhalgh J Degenhardt
runners.spotlight: Useful and progressive form at 7f before a good step forward on his handicap debut, rattling home for second in the Britannia at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm); a 5lb rise should be manageable and he has to enter the reckoning despite the subsequent 261-day absence.

runners.comment: Admirable performer but surely one or two will prove better handicapped
runners.name: Two Tempting
runners.spotlight: He was making his seasonal debut when only fifth in this race 12 months ago but he's been kept on the go this winter and has been better than ever; suspicion others will prove better handicapped here though.

runners.comment: Won this race in 2024 and 3rd last year; 7f winner ten days ago; still on a handy mark
runners.name: Kingdom Come
runners.spotlight: Smart performer on AW, winning this race in 2024 and third 12 months ago; cheekpieces have given him a lift of late, winning a 7f handicap at Kempton ten days ago; still on a handy mark and he is sure to be popular.

runners.comment: Unexposed 4yo won won cosily over 1m2f last week; up 6lb but doubt he has reached his peak
runners.name: Regal Ulixes
runners.spotlight: Lightly-raced 4yo who took his form to a new level when readily seeing off ten rivals at Lingfield last week (1m2f); a 6lb rise shouldn't be beyond him and he can't be discounted stepping back in distance.

runners.comment: Useful on AW; can step up on last week's return to action; each-way shout
runners.name: Superposition
runners.spotlight: Well suited by AW and although he is yet to win off a mark this high, he has plenty of form that gives him a fighting chance; can step up on last week's return to action and he holds each-way claims.

runners.comment: 7f Kempton win in January has worked out superbly; unsuited by tactical race latest; solid
runners.name: The Lost King
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who returned from a 202-day break (gelded during the absence) to win a 7f handicap at Kempton in January, finishing off strongly (form worked out extremely well); only second over 1m last time but the tactical nature of that race may not have suited; still looks on a dangerous mark and he's one of two strong contenders for Andrew Balding.

runners.comment: 3-6 overall and 2-3 on AW; still has potential and he holds each-way claims at least
runners.name: First Principle
runners.spotlight: The winner of three of his six starts and two of them have come on AW; second to Two Tempting at Kempton when last seen in November but he had beaten that rival on his previous start and is handicapped to confirm the placings; one to consider.

runners.comment: Overcame trouble to win a 7f handicap at Lingfield in December; up 2lb; not discounted
runners.name: Christian David
runners.spotlight: Overcame trouble in running to win a 7f handicap at Lingfield in December (blinkered first time); only 2lb higher which looks manageable; stays 1m but this additional 142 yards will be new territory.

runners.comment: Smart in France/Ireland but not beaten a rival in 3 runs for new yard; too much to prove
runners.name: Bravais
runners.spotlight: Smart form in France and Ireland but he hasn't beaten a rival in three runs for Ian Williams this winter; dropped 10lb but far too much to prove for comfort.

runners.comment: Two AW wins to his name; needs to step up on reappearance run but still has low mileage
runners.name: First Ambition
runners.spotlight: Free-going sort who has won two of his six starts; should be sharper with last month's Southwell reappearance behind him and still has some potential.

runners.comment: Five handicap wins in a productive 2025 campaign; needs to improve again but it's possible
runners.name: Knights Gold
runners.spotlight: Five handicap wins in a productive 2025 campaign; only midfield off this mark when last seen at Goodwood in October; needs to progress again but it is not out of the question.

runners.comment: In good form but January's wins were in Class 4 company; a career best is required
runners.name: High On Hope
runners.spotlight: Won Class 4 handicaps at Chelmsford and Kempton in January; respectable efforts in stronger company twice since but he needs a career best to take this.

runners.comment: Gimcrack winner as a 2yo; good return from long absence in January; good chance back to 7f
runners.name: Cool Hoof Luke
runners.spotlight: 6f AW win on his 2yo debut; took his form to another level when winning the Group 2 Gimcrack Stakes at York; returned from a 526-day absence with a good third in a 6f Listed race at Lingfield five weeks ago and he should be sharper today; drawn widest back up at 7f but still a leading contender.

runners.comment: Good record on AW but at 6f; solid form claims if stamina lasts
runners.name: Ferrous
runners.spotlight: Good record on AW; as good as ever this year, finishing fourth (behind Cool Hoof Luke) in a Listed race at Lingfield five weeks ago and then second in a handicap back at Lingfield last week; stamina for 7f has to be taken on trust (one turf attempt saw him finish tailed off) but he hasn't got much to find on form.

runners.breeder: Mr & Mrs P Hopper Mr & Mrs M Morris
runners.comment: Still improving as a 5yo; can't be recommended at weights but likely to outrun his odds
runners.name: Heathcliff
runners.spotlight: Still improving and his latest Lingfield success (7f) was just reward for a string of good placed efforts this year; has a stiff task at the weights but likely he will fare better than they suggest.

runners.comment: Huge chance on 2025 AW best but two runs this winter haven't been at that level; new trip
runners.name: Marshman
runners.owner: Nick Bradley Racing 2 & Mrs E Burke
runners.spotlight: Strong AW form in the first half of 2025; awkward leaving the stalls in his two runs this winter and the form has been well short of his best; steps up to 7f for the first time.

runners.comment: Steadily progressive 5yo; 7f around a left-hand turn suits him well; has a big run in him
runners.name: Palmar Bay
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive 5yo, including two 7f handicap wins last year; took form to a higher level when fourth of 15 in a Listed race at Deauville (7.5f) in December, never far away in a race where the pace held up; should have another big run in him.

runners.comment: C&D winner; hugely progressive at 6f last year; could progress further as a 4yo
runners.name: Prince Of India
runners.spotlight: C&D novice win 12 months ago; rapid improver when dropped to 6f, winning good handicaps at Newmarket and Ascot in the summer before a close third in a York Listed event in September; disappointed at Ascot when last seen in October but that run is easy to excuse; interesting with further progress a real possibility this year.

runners.comment: Ended 2025 in good form but he faces a stiff task on his seasonal return
runners.name: Thunder Roar
runners.spotlight: Useful handicapper; beat 13 rivals at Ayr in September (1m, soft) and showed better form when second at York when last seen 148 days ago (1m, good); tough task on his seasonal return.

runners.comment: Second in this race last year and he is enjoying a good winter; each-way shout
runners.name: Witch Hunter
runners.spotlight: Ran on to take second in the corresponding race last year; in good order this winter, including a 1m win at Newcastle in January, and he shouldn't be too far away.

15:50.race_name: Win £250,000 With BetMGM's Golden Goals Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Modest form on last month's Chelmsford debut; he would be a surprise winner
runners.name: Claytons Kolatonic
runners.spotlight: 80-1 when running to a modest level on last month's Chelmsford debut; he would be a surprise winner.

runners.comment: Dam a maiden, herself a daughter of an Oaks runner-up; starts out in an uncompetitive race
runners.name: Showcasing Star
runners.spotlight: First foal of a maiden, herself a daughter of Oaks runner-up Something Exciting; already gelded; starts out in an uncompetitive maiden.

runners.comment: Unable to justify favouritism on debut but shaped with promise; open to plenty of progress
runners.name: Sintra
runners.spotlight: Useful pedigree and he was sent off the 6-4 favourite for his Newcastle debut (1m) last month, eventually finishing third having been tapped for speed when the pace finally picked up; open to considerable improvement.

runners.comment: Similar form in two 7f runs on Polytrack; could do with settling better; sets the standard
runners.name: Zambezi River
runners.spotlight: January's Kempton debut (7f) was full of promise and he improved his RPR slightly when second at Chelmsford last month (again 7f; beaten odds-on favourite); he will need to settle better now up in trip but he remains capable of better.

16:25.race_name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap

runners.comment: Conditions to suit and ran well at Newcastle eight weeks ago; more appealing than most
runners.name: Henery Hawk
runners.spotlight: Two of his six wins have come over C&D; good third at Newcastle eight weeks ago and he has sound claims if ready to roll after the break.

runners.comment: Won a 6f classified event at Newcastle last summer; opposable back at 5f after a break
runners.name: Colour Code
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 17th attempt when winning a 6f classified event in good style last August (6f, Tapeta); well beaten when last seen in November and this slow-starter looks vulnerable back at 5f after a break.

runners.comment: Runner-up six times this winter; may have to make do with more minor money
runners.name: Colors Of Freedom
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner but she's caught a dose of seconditis this winter, runner-up six times since December; drawn widest and may have to make do with more minor money.

runners.comment: Poor form in three AW runs last autumn; more realistic assignment today but still risky
runners.name: Washington Heir
runners.spotlight: Poor form in three 6f runs on AW last autumn; more realistic task now handicapping; one of three runners for Tony Carroll.

runners.comment: Poor strike-rate but arrives in form and he seems highly likely to give his running
runners.name: Kento
runners.spotlight: Just one win to his name from 25 starts but it came over C&D; runner-up in both start last month and he has been placed on each occasion Rossa Ryan has been on board; more likely than many to give his running.

runners.comment: Fair run in a 6f classified here last week; not discounted back in a handicap; yard run 3
runners.name: Port Hedland
runners.spotlight: Infrequent winner; operating off a lowly mark now and he ran a fair race here last week when third of nine in a 0-50 classified event (6f); not discounted back in a handicap; stable run three here.

runners.comment: Regressive 8yo; penultimate C&D 4th was a fair run but he failed to back it up last time
runners.name: Symbol Of Hope
runners.spotlight: Regressive 8yo who has been unable to exploit his reduced mark this winter; his penultimate C&D fourth wasn't a bad effort but others still make more appeal for win purposes.

17:00.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap

runners.comment: Record of 21221 in 5f AW handicaps this winter; should give her running once again
runners.name: Rosieisme Darling
runners.spotlight: Record in 5f handicaps this winter reads 21221 and she took her form to a higher level when seeing off five rivals at Lingfield ten days ago; up 3lb but she should remain competitive.

runners.comment: Overcame a wide trip to win a 6f handicap here last week; a 3lb rise looks manageable
runners.name: Elashgar
runners.spotlight: Stepped up on his maiden/novice form when making a successful handicap debut (6f) here last week, travelling strongly and having enough in reserve to hold the late challenge of the runner-up; he was caught wide throughout on that occasion and the effort can be marked up; drop to 5f should be fine and a 3lb rise looks manageable; big player.

runners.comment: Not progressing but he has shown good speed on his last two starts; drop to 5f could help
runners.name: Kanes A Lott
runners.owner: David N Reynolds & C D Watkins
runners.spotlight: Set a strong pace before weakening into sixth of 11, beaten 4.5l, behind Elashgar here (6f) last week; continues to edge down the weights and dropping to 5f may help.

runners.comment: Low-key handicap debut but a hint of promise in novice company beforehand; can do better
runners.name: Backfire
runners.spotlight: Dropped right away having raced freely in a 7f handicap here in January, her second run for new connections; had hinted at ability in novice company though and she could still have a bigger run in her; drops to 5f for the first time.

runners.comment: Poor form since joining Micky Hammond; she looks opposable once again
runners.name: Resdev Kisses
runners.spotlight: Whiff of promise for the Easterbys but she has been well beaten in four starts for her new stable; difficult to recommend.

runners.comment: Beaten just one rival home in three 6f runs this year; down in trip for handicap debut
runners.name: Sequential
runners.spotlight: Sent off at huge prices and she has only beaten one rival home in her three runs in 6f maiden/novice races this year; she needs a  transformation dropped to 5f for her handicap debut.

runners.comment: Poor form in his six starts; a change of headgear isn't enough to tempt
runners.name: Sands Of Seve
runners.spotlight: Poor form in his six starts, faring no better for a gelding operation at Southwell four weeks ago; new headgear on today but others are safer.

runners.comment: Generally consistent for current yard but still has a modest strike-rate
runners.name: Londoner
runners.spotlight: Did too much up front last time (doesn't normally lead); generally consistent otherwise for current yard and could go well but whether he's going to defy top weight is another matter; still has a modest strike-rate.

runners.comment: Record of 1112413 since racing in AW handicaps, the most recent win over C&D; solid
runners.name: Towerlands
runners.spotlight: Maiden prior to producing form figures of 1112413 since racing in AW handicaps, the most recent success over C&D; ran creditably in higher grade at Lingfield (1m4f) last time; solid claims off unaltered mark.

runners.comment: Record of 10-33 on AW includes a success in this race (off just 1lb lower) last year
runners.name: Arcadian Nights
runners.spotlight: Record of 10-33 on AW features six wins at Wolverhampton, including in this race (off just 1lb lower) last year; close fourth at Lingfield for an encouraging start to his 2026 campaign; fighting chance.

runners.comment: Slightly resurgent last time but has still never won away from Chelmsford
runners.name: Cristo
runners.spotlight: Solid spell on AW last spring; not in the same form since being gelded and returning from a layoff but latest effort was a resurgence of sorts; however, he's 2-2 at Chelmsford compared to 0-11 elsewhere.

runners.comment: All wins over 1m3f/1m4f; the 8yo has something to prove back down in trip
runners.name: Way Of Life
runners.spotlight: Has gained all wins over 1m3f/1m4f, including at Southwell (narrowly) in October when last seen; the 8yo is still competitively treated on historical data but has something to prove back down in trip.

runners.comment: Good strike-rate, including at Wolverhampton, since November; progressing well with age
runners.name: Mr Nugget
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism at Southwell most recently, making it three wins from his last four starts and taking strike-rate since November to 5-11; has a particularly good record at Wolverhampton in that period; progressing well with age and warrants respect off bottom weight upped further in class.

13:32.race_name: Weddings At Western House Novices' Hurdle (Go North Night Nurse Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Won over hurdles at Lingfield in November and solid second the following month.
runners.name: Gatineau Park
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who scored on his second start over hurdles at Lingfield (2m3f, good to soft) in November; improved again, chasing home one who has won twice since, at Wincanton (2m4f, soft) the following month; sports a first-time tongue-tie and should be hard to beat.

runners.breeder: E A R L Elevage Des Loges
runners.comment: Won on hurdles debut at Hexham in November, but only fourth over 3m last time.
runners.name: Out Of The Woods
runners.spotlight: Soft-ground bumper winner who scored in good style on hurdle debut at Hexham (2m4f, good to soft) in November; showed no improvement for stepping up in trip when fourth of five at Musselburgh (3m, good to soft) in January but has possibilities back down in distance/grade.

runners.breeder: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C
runners.comment: Made winning hurdles debut at Hexham in December; solid third in Grade 2 last time.
runners.name: Tashkhan
runners.spotlight: A very useful four-time winner on the Flat, he got off to a winning start over hurdles at Hexham (2m4f, heavy) in December; stayed on well to snatch third up in trip in a Grade 2 at Haydock (3m, good to soft) three weeks ago; holds obvious credentials back down in grade.

runners.comment: Second to Tashkhan at Hexham in December but below that form last time.
runners.name: Cushendun
runners.spotlight: Still a maiden but was beaten only half a length by Tashkhan at Hexham (2m4f, heavy) in December and is 7lb better off with that rival; below that form when sixth of eight finishers at Ayr (2m4f, soft) the following month and needs to bounce back.

runners.breeder: S C E A De LAubay & Guillaume Cousin
runners.comment: Won an Irish maiden point last February but beaten 20l and 49l in two hurdles starts.
runners.name: Malayalam
runners.owner: Two Black Labs And A Fox Red
runners.spotlight: Bought for £75,000 last April having won an Irish maiden point in February (3m, heavy) but beaten 20l and 49l in two hurdles starts; needs to show more.

runners.comment: Made no impression when sixth on hurdles debut at Perth in May.
runners.name: Mosstown Mill
runners.spotlight: Won four-runner Irish point (good) last April but made no impression when sixth of ten finishers on hurdles debut at Perth (2m, good; 33-1) the following month; steps up in trip but has plenty on here.

runners.comment: Dismal claims on form
runners.name: Run Baby Run
runners.spotlight: Has dismal claims on form; steps up in trip but easy to looks elsewhere.

14:07.race_name: Western House Hotel New Brunch Menu Handicap Chase (Go North One Man Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: Mme Clarence Signol & Mr Xavier Brelaud
runners.comment: Regressive 9yo but has two wins over C&D and has won off 9lb higher.
runners.name: Netywell
runners.spotlight: Regressive 9yo who is sliding down the weights; has two wins over C&D and has won off 9lb higher so cannot be discounted.

runners.breeder: J C Haimet & A F Peter
runners.comment: Won three over fences in 2023 but has yet to rediscover his form after a lengthy absence
runners.name: One Mill Harbour
runners.spotlight: Won three over fences in 2023; has yet to rediscover his form this term after an absence of 25 months but Brian Hughes rides for the first time.

runners.comment: Scored over C&D off this mark last February but yet to recapture his form this term.
runners.name: Dance Thief
runners.spotlight: Scored over C&D (good to soft) off this mark last February but yet to recapture his form this term; pulled up here (2m4f, soft) 12 days ago.

runners.comment: Two wins this season, on good ground at Kelso and soft over C&D.
runners.name: Ballyfort
runners.spotlight: Two wins this season, on good ground at Kelso and soft over C&D; still on a competitive mark if a line can be put through his latest effort when tailed off over this C&D.

runners.comment: Always behind on return from break at Carlisle last month.
runners.name: Cuzco Du Mathan
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been at Cartmel; always behind on return from break at Carlisle (2m4f, good to soft) last month; sliding down the weights but hard to fancy.

runners.comment: Not solid on his form for new yard but reapplied cheekpieces may have positive effect.
runners.name: Don Occhetti
runners.spotlight: Won for Dan Skelton at Worcester in August 2024 (last attempt in cheekpieces); not solid on his form for new yard this year following lengthy absence but reapplied headgear may have positive effect.

14:47.race_name: Mothers Day Lunch At Western House Mares' Handicap Hurdle (For The Ayrshire Yeomanry Cup) (Qual')

runners.comment: Not at best this season but ran okay over 3m last time and is edging down the weights
runners.name: Foxs Fancy
runners.spotlight: Close second in this race a year ago (soft ground); not in same form this season but put in good front-running shift before weakening into fifth here (3m, soft) five weeks ago and continues to edge down the weights.

runners.breeder: Sir J Timpson & H D J Daly
runners.comment: 2-5 over hurdles; off since autumn and unproven on soft going but may still have potential
runners.name: Keep On Cobbling
runners.spotlight: 2-5 over hurdles, the latter win gained on seasonal/handicap debut at Sedgefield (2m5f, good) in November; not seen since lesser effort later than month and not yet tested on ground slower than good to soft but may still have potential.
