runners.comment: Suitably bred debutante, being related to a couple of bumper scorers
runners.name: Moyanna
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to 2m6f hurdle winner Game On; dam bumper/2m hurdle scorer, half-sister to useful winner Pembroke (bumper and 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase); suitably bred debutante.

runners.comment: Modest fourth of six at Stratford
runners.name: Nautical Queen
runners.spotlight: Modest fourth of six at Stratford five months ago; opposed.

runners.comment: Needs to step up markedly on her AW effort
runners.name: Nowherenearmilan
runners.spotlight: Needs to step up markedly on her Newcastle AW effort.

runners.comment: Stayed on from rear for promising efforts at Huntingdon (Listed) and Ascot; the form pick
runners.name: One Dimensional
runners.spotlight: Has stayed on from rear for promising efforts at Huntingdon (fifth in Listed grade) and Ascot (second behind an Alan King newcomer); may need the cards to drop right but she is the form pick.

runners.comment: Tailed-off last of ten at Wincanton
runners.name: Saffron Belle
runners.spotlight: Tailed-off last of ten at Wincanton for an inauspicious debut.

runners.comment: Solid third at Kempton and Ludlow; form has been franked and she's bred to do better still
runners.name: Seven Stars
runners.spotlight: Solid third at Kempton and Ludlow last year; both pieces of form have been franked by the winners since; bred to do better still, being related to several scorers for her stable; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Fitting of hood needs to make a big difference
runners.name: Six Blue
runners.spotlight: Two duck eggs next to her name; fitting of hood needs to make a big difference.

runners.breeder: S C E A De La Vallee De LOrne
runners.comment: Made the frame at Warwick while looking in need of the outing/experience
runners.name: Mega Etoile
runners.spotlight: Registered a modest figure in making the frame at Warwick but gave the impression she may improve with the outing/experience under her belt.

runners.comment: Twice-raced filly who is related to bumper winners and remains open to improvement
runners.name: Roxy Russet
runners.spotlight: Never landed a blow at Newbury (behind Wait For This) but was prominent when falling 4f out at Huntingdon; related to a few bumper winners and remains open to improvement.

runners.comment: Twice-raced filly whose pedigree suggests she should do better still
runners.name: Wait For This
runners.spotlight: Ran encouragingly at Newbury; failed to show improvement at Ludlow but pedigree suggests she should do better still; one of three runners who receive a sizeable 4yo allowance.

17:30.race_name: UK Garage Raceday Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: 100,000euros yearling who's a half-brother to a few useful winners; interesting newcomer
runners.name: Bay Of Myths
runners.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling who's a half-brother to a few useful winners, including Arisaig (here on 2yo debut), Folkswood (Group 3) and Good Omen; looks an interesting newcomer.

runners.comment: Well off the front pair for his new yard a fortnight ago; likely there's better to come
runners.name: Ghaiyyath Deer
runners.spotlight: Below market expectations in one run for Dermot Weld early in the year and finished well off the front pair for his new yard at Lingfield a fortnight ago; likely there's better to come from him but maybe in handicaps.

runners.comment: Been gelded and sports first-time headgear, which will need to make a big difference
runners.name: Joyful Lawyer
runners.spotlight: Easy to back and finished well held in two starts on Tapeta late last year; since been gelded and sports first-time headgear, which will need to make a big difference.

runners.comment: Gelded 800,000gns half-brother to Irish 2,000 Guineas winner Mac Swiney; likely type
runners.name: Montevetro
runners.spotlight: Gelded 800,000gns yearling who's a half-brother to Irish 2,000 Guineas winner Mac Swiney; yard 5-8 with 3yos this year and has a 30% strike-rate with them here in the last five seasons; looks to have been found an ordinary maiden on debut.

runners.comment: Well held in two runs late last year; goes up in trip back from a break
runners.name: Rumbustious
runners.spotlight: Related to winners but finished well held in two runs late last year; goes up in trip back from a break and needs a big step forward if he's to get involved.

runners.comment: Slowly into stride and said to have run green on debut; should do much better
runners.name: Free Yourself
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to the yard's Group 3 winner (1m2f, Polytrack) Berlin Tango; ran below her market billing on debut at Wolverhampton recently; slowly into stride and said to have run green that night, and should do much better.

runners.comment: Easy to back, shaped with a lot of promise on his Newbury debut last April; obvious chance
runners.name: Beagle Bay
runners.spotlight: Easy to back but shaped with a lot of promise on his Newbury debut last April (equally unlucky third proved very useful subsequently); sets a clear standard on that for a trainer who boasts a good record with runners here down the seasons.

runners.comment: 33-1, missed the break and finished well beaten on her 1m Kempton debut a few weeks ago
runners.name: Achalugo
runners.spotlight: 92,000euros breeze-up 2yo who had wind surgery last November; 33-1, missed the break and finished well beaten on her 1m Kempton debut a few weeks ago; may be one for handicaps down the line.

runners.comment: Gelded 22,000gns 2yo who has stamina on the dam's side of his pedigree; market will guide
runners.name: Bumaan
runners.spotlight: Gelded 22,000gns 2yo who has stamina on the dam's side of his pedigree but whose useful half-brother Tafreej won over 6f and 1m; the market will guide on debut.

runners.comment: £32,000 yearling; the market usually speaks loud with trainer's newcomers
runners.name: Different Opinions
runners.spotlight: £32,000 yearling who's a half-brother to dual 5f winner Military Girl (won second time out as a 2yo and on her 3yo comeback); the market usually speaks loud with trainer's newcomers.

runners.comment: Massive prices for two Lingfield starts in the winter, finishing a remote last each time
runners.name: Serragasso
runners.spotlight: Started massive prices for two Lingfield starts in the winter, finishing a remote last each time; since been gelded.

runners.comment: Needed the experience badly last summer; this rather easier for a yard going well of late
runners.name: Wield
runners.spotlight: Brother to a Grade 2 winner and half-brother to several other very useful winners; faced a tough task on his debut last summer; finished a remote last there but needed the experience badly and this is somewhat easier for a yard going well of late.

runners.comment: Won well for new yard under a penalty in a Lingfield novice recently; open to improvement
runners.name: Elements Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Breaks between his three runs; last spring's turf fourth worked out well and he made it 2-2 on the AW, having been picked up from the Gosdens for 32,000gns and gelded, under a penalty in a Lingfield novice for new yard recently; open to improvement.

runners.breeder: Haras De Saint Julien & Mme Regula Vanno
runners.comment: Inconsistent for this yard; hard to recommend against some in-form, less-exposed rivals
runners.name: Society Man
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 6yo who's proven inconsistent for this yard and pulled hard in first-time cheekpieces (removed tonight) on Tapeta a month ago; 2lb lower than for last autumn's Kempton win but is hard to recommend against some in-form, less-exposed rivals.

runners.comment: Held in small-field seller here nine days ago; first run at shy of 1m since his 2yo debut
runners.name: Epictetus
runners.spotlight: Group 3 winner for the Gosden yard as a 3yo but regressed last season; allowed his own way in front when held in a small-field seller here nine days ago and is having a first run at shy of 1m since his 2yo debut.

runners.comment: All four starts over 1m at Newcastle; too soon to write him off but has a bit to prove
runners.name: Inspired
runners.owner: Fine Claret RacingMrs Burke & C Wood
runners.spotlight: All four starts over 1m at Newcastle, twice getting turned over as favourite having won an ordinary maiden late last year; shapes as though he'll be fine with the drop in trip and it's too soon to write him off but he has a bit to prove now.

runners.comment: Won well over C&D nine days ago (first-time visor); a 6lb rise has forced him up in class
runners.name: Captain Parma
runners.spotlight: Career-best effort in a first-time visor, switched from cheekpieces, and under Mason Paetel for the first time when winning well over C&D nine days ago; things fell ideally that night and a 6lb rise has forced him up in class; has more on his plate.

runners.breeder: North Cheshire Trading And Storage Ltd
runners.comment: Race run to suit in a first-time visor on Tapeta last week; a 2lb rise seems fair though
runners.name: Grabajabba
runners.spotlight: Landed a third Tapeta win, in a race run to suit those coming from off the pace, when prevailing in a first-time visor last week; a 2lb rise seems fair but whether this easier 7f in a smaller field plays to his strengths remains to be seen.

runners.comment: Below par since two Southwell wins last autumn and the first-time visor will need to help
runners.name: Ararat
runners.spotlight: Front-runner whose three wins for David Simcock, including here, came over 7f; added two more victories over this trip round Southwell last autumn but not at best since and the first-time visor will need to help over tonight's easier 6f.

runners.comment: This is a bit easier for a yard among the winners, should the race be set up for him
runners.name: Thurso
runners.spotlight: Hold-up performer who stays 7f and has never done it off a mark quite this high; this is a bit easier for a yard among the winners, though, should the race be set up for him.

runners.comment: Ten-time AW winner; boasts a consistent C&D record but could be high enough in the weights
runners.name: Tyger Bay
runners.spotlight: Ten-time AW winner who boasts a consistent record over C&D; high enough in the weights but his latest Kempton effort, back from a break, is best overlooked and the return here won't hurt.

runners.comment: Not as good now but remains consistent enough and unlikely to be far away
runners.name: Whenthedealinsdone
runners.spotlight: Notched a hat-trick in the first three months of last year, latterly off a 1lb lower mark; not as good now but remains consistent enough and unlikely to be far away.

runners.comment: 5lb penalty wouldn't have stopped her Tuesday; this stronger but she's the one to beat
runners.name: Spendmore Lane
runners.spotlight: Finally off the mark over 5f here a fortnight ago and, confidence boosted, duly followed up easily from the front at Wolverhampton on Tuesday; a 5lb penalty wouldn't have stopped her there and, while this is stronger back up to 6f, she's the one to beat.

runners.comment: Struggled in four runs over hurdles for his current yard; hard to make a case for
runners.name: Marhaba Million
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden for two yards on the Flat and has struggled in four runs over hurdles for his current trainer; hard to make a case for.

runners.comment: Faring respectably in similar company of late; one to consider in a handicap lacking depth
runners.name: D Day Arvalenreeva
runners.spotlight: Rare Flat runner for her jumps-oriented yard; has been faring respectably in similar company of late, latterly in a Kempton handicap that didn't pan out ideally; one to consider.

runners.comment: Obvious claims if as effective over this longer trip upped 3lb as she tries to make it 4-5
runners.name: Sea Of Charm
runners.spotlight: Three-time turf winner last year who started a big price when going in again on her Lingfield comeback three weeks ago; has to prove she's as effective over this longer trip upped 3lb, but an interesting contender nonetheless under 7lb claimer Harry Vigors.

runners.comment: Wildly inconsistent gelding; will need to leave two poor efforts behind
runners.name: Upepo
runners.spotlight: Wildly inconsistent gelding who's always been happiest round Lingfield, the scene of his December win off 5lb lower; this is a bit easier but he'll need to leave two poor efforts behind.

runners.comment: Looked to have no excuses off this mark over C&D last time; needs to find a bit more
runners.name: Mio Amico
runners.spotlight: Looked to have no excuses off this mark over C&D last time, having scrambled home off 3lb lower previously (both for Kyle McHugh); needs to find a bit more.

runners.comment: Tried in first-time blinkers on this second run since a wind op; little to recommend him
runners.name: Majestic Leo
runners.spotlight: String of poor efforts under both codes since picked up from Ralph Beckett, and is tried in first-time blinkers on this second run since undergoing wind surgery; little to recommend him.

runners.comment: Back in form when arguably an unlucky loser at Wolverhampton on Tuesday; obvious claims
runners.name: Queensland Boy
runners.spotlight: Last three wins, including two for Ryan Kavanagh last spring, have come over further; back in form when arguably an unlucky loser at Wolverhampton on Tuesday (extended 2m) and his claims are obvious off the same mark.

runners.comment: Didn't achieve much when fourth over C&D nine days ago; needs to improve a deal on that
runners.name: Bloodhound
runners.spotlight: Yard been quiet for a while and this longstanding maiden didn't achieve much when fourth over C&D nine days ago; will need to improve a deal on that.

20:00.race_name: For The Love Of Horses Handicap

runners.comment: 5lb rise demands more but she may well be up to the job in a handicap lacking depth
runners.name: Desdemona
runners.spotlight: Handicapper quick to ease off this winter and things fell ideally from a wide stall at Lingfield ten days ago, having previously bumped into one there over 6f; a 5lb rise demands more but she may well be up to the job in a handicap lacking depth.

runners.comment: Nine-time course winner, including over 6f off a 2lb lower mark early in the year; capable
runners.name: Sir Rodneyredblood
runners.spotlight: Nine-time course winner, most recently over 6f off a 2lb lower mark early in the year; knocking on in years and lacks consistency these days but remains capable at this level.

runners.comment: Good record over C&D and at this time of year; solid effort here latest; decent claims
runners.name: Buraback
runners.spotlight: Two wins, a second, a third and three fourths to his name in seven runs over C&D and boasts a decent record at this time of the years; chased home a subsequent winner under Jack Callan here a fortnight ago off the same mark and goes on the shortlist.

runners.comment: This mark within range; goes without the hood tonight; has been expensive to follow
runners.name: Top Star
runners.spotlight: Has shown enough in two runs back from a lengthy absence (gelded in the interim) for this yard to suggest this mark is within range; goes without the hood tonight; was expensive to follow for Richard Hughes, though, and remains a maiden.

runners.comment: Remains winless after 21 starts and has been running over 6f of late; each-way shout
runners.name: Daley T
runners.spotlight: Remains winless after 21 starts and has been running over 6f of late; better off back into handicap company, from 0-50 classifieds, in theory but others make more appeal.

runners.comment: Sole victory came first time up last year after a similar break; lost his way later on
runners.name: Master Zack
runners.spotlight: Sole victory came first time up last season, back from a similar break, so has that in his favour; lost his way in 2025, however, and the usual hood and tongue-tie are both missing.

runners.comment: Poor maiden for four yards who hasn't been seen in a year; worth a look in the market
runners.name: Hi Hoh Tonto
runners.spotlight: Poor maiden for four previous yards who hasn't been seen in a year; new trainer has done well with runners picked up from elsewhere, though, and he's worth a look in the market.

runners.comment: Almost three years since his sole win; Desdemona looks his yard's best chance
runners.name: Battle Point
runners.spotlight: Almost three years since his sole win; ran as well as he was entitled to on tough terms in a 0-50 classified event last time, back from a break; Desdemona looks his yard's best chance.

20:30.race_name: Chelmsford Mile Series Qualifier Handicap (Chelmsford Mile Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Solid effort in a race not run to suit last time; little room for manoeuvre off this mark
runners.name: Renesmee
runners.spotlight: Three wins last year, including here (1m2f) off 5lb lower in November; solid effort in a race not run to suit on Tapeta last time (best of those held up) and, while there's little room for manoeuvre off this mark, she holds fair claims on that.

runners.comment: Finding his level now and it wouldn't shock were he to pop up here, dropped another 3lb
runners.name: Nordic Norm
runners.spotlight: Started handicap life for Karl Burke last summer on an unrealistic mark and struggled prior to being picked up for just 2,000gns in the autumn; finding his level now for his current yard and it wouldn't shock were he to pop up here, dropped another 3lb.

runners.comment: On career-high mark but more likely than most to give his running, possibly from the front
runners.name: H Key Lails
runners.spotlight: Consistent spell under Ryan Kavanagh during the winter but resumes from a short break still on a career-high mark as a result (3lb above his highest successful rating); more likely than most to give his running, though, possibly from the front again.

runners.comment: At his best this time last year; likes Lingfield and needs to find more off 4lb higher
runners.name: Antiquity
runners.owner: P&h Moorhead J Collins And S Piper
runners.spotlight: At his best around this time last year and took advantage of a sliding mark when justifying favouritism a fortnight ago; evidently likes Lingfield, has his quirks and now needs to back that up off a 4lb higher rating.

runners.comment: Picked up for 7,500gns; interesting to see how he goes in the market after six months off
runners.name: Pivotal Days
runners.spotlight: Heavy-ground nursery winner for Ed Walker off this mark who struggled during a limited campaign last year before being picked up for 7,500gns (rare Flat runner for his new yard); interesting to see how he goes in the market after six months off.

runners.comment: Poor debut for his new yard and the hood and tongue-tie both come off; hard to recommend
runners.name: Dalmally
runners.spotlight: Expensive to follow for Hughie Morrison, turned over as favourite four times, before being sold for 2,000gns last backend; made a poor debut for his new yard three weeks ago and the hood and tongue-tie both come off; hard to recommend.

runners.comment: Won four times during the winter; won't mind going back up in trip; decent chance again
runners.name: Royal Jet
runners.spotlight: Won four times during the winter (7f-1m) and has gone up more than a stone in the weights, having been nudged up another 2lb for last weekend's Lingfield second; won't mind going back up in trip, though, and has a decent chance of adding to his tally.
